data.title: Iran's president says country won't surrender after Trump threat to 'annihilate' Islamic Republic | CBC News
data.description: Iranian President ‌Masoud Pezeshkian did not mince words in a rare wartime speech at the United Nations General Assembly on Wednesday, a day after U.S. President Donald Trump suggested he may "annihilate" Iran amid the nearly seven-month war on the Islamic Republic.
